name: 多片量贩家用暖通滤网囤货款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼看清这是同规格多片量贩装，赢得首次点击
shots.textZone: none, 白底主图必须无字

shots.intent: 一秒讲清拦污与通风的取舍关系，承接首图点击后的第一问
shots.textZone: 上部留白带一行主卖点位 「{selling_point_1}」，其下一行短句位 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 把脏堵旧网与干净新网的直观落差摊开，制造更换紧迫感
shots.textZone: 右栏顶部一行短句位 「{callout_1}」，左栏顶部仅一条空白标题带

shots.intent: 用三向空白引线与空规格卡消除尺寸与适配疑虑
shots.textZone: 右侧规格卡内两行空白尺寸位与一行短句位 「{callout_2}」，三条引线仅标 Width / Length / Depth

shots.intent: 让用户代入自家回风口位置，把更换看成零门槛动作
用侧剖三层构造与放大镜解释做工，撑起品质感
shots.textZone: 左侧三行说明位各一行，首行 「{callout_3}」，其余两行为空白槽位

shots.intent: 微距证明褶层纤维与纸框压合做工，撑起价值感
双栏同框对照让买家自行选折纹结构，收口犹豫
shots.textZone: 左栏顶部一行主卖点位 「{selling_point_2}」，右栏顶部一条空白标题带，八行对照位全为空白槽

shots.intent: 一排同族包装与裸网堆叠讲清囤货规格，让用户自选
shots.textZone: 各包面一行空白标签行与一条空白参数带，顶部一条空白对照带

shots.intent: 以全内含物平铺与空白更换记录贴收口，消除到货疑虑
shots.textZone: 上部一行主卖点位 「{selling_point_3}」，日期贴上一律空白槽位不写字

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, spec flat lays and macro plates, stone-grey graphic fields #D8DDDB for mechanism screens, deep green #0F7A3D and teal #12A3C0 used as flat colour-block fields for structure, comparison and closing layouts; real painted drywall only inside the one installation photograph
style.direction: clean HVAC value-pack consumery commerce, flat colour-block graphic screens alternating with bright packshots
style.iconSystem: flat thin-line pictograms in single-stroke teal #12A3C0 or white inside blank circular chips, plain check shapes and open-ended leader lines, no gradients, no shading, no captions
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light at 5600K from the front-left with a soft fill on the shadow side and one soft contact shadow under every unit; flat shadowless graphic light at 5600K on colour-block screens with one consistent upper-left direction; macro and structure views lit with a cool low-intensity skimming sweep
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean HVAC value-pack ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, stone grey #D8DDDB, deep green #0F7A3D and one teal accent #12A3C0; cool neutral lighting with a bright even high-key front-left key at 5600K plus one soft contact shadow for packshots and flat shadowless graphic light with one consistent upper-left direction on colour-block screens; modern geometric sans-serif with oversized headline bands and one short label row per element; flat thin-line pictograms in single-stroke teal or white inside blank circular chips; flat colour-block graphic screens and bright packshots, with photographic inserts used only in the pain-point cards and the one installation scene; stable upright square-to-frame product scale and identical scale between paired panels; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no photographic backgrounds on graphic screens, no inconsistent lighting, no real brand marks or badge artwork, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no photographic backgrounds on graphic screens
no inconsistent light direction between paired panels
no real brand marks, origin flags, certification artwork, grade letters or rating numbers
no invented figures inside parameter bands, count windows, leader lines or date tabs
style.presentationRules: pack upright and square to the frame on graphic fields, identical scale between paired panels and between lineup packs, filter media shown at the same face-on or edge-on attitude, one soft contact shadow under every unit, product never clipped
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white studio sweep #FFFFFF, matte stone-grey plates #D8DDDB beneath detail and macro views, printed board and pleated media textures kept unretouched, real drywall and a metal grille housing only inside the installation scene
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only, oversized headline bands, one short label row per element, generous margins, every word left as a blank slot or a callout placeholder
